label: Onager
description: One heavy Classical Roman onager, a broad reinforced oak wheeled frame with a conspicuous transverse thick rope torsion bundle, tall paired timber support tops and a long north-south throwing arm ending in a visible rope SLING holding one stone. Make it heavier, broader and more reinforced than a compact bucket catapult; SLING and rope distinguish it, no wooden spoon bucket. Exactly FOUR Classical crew in crimson and cream tunics, rounded bronze helmet crowns and leather equipment, two flanking each side. Only horizontal beam tops are visible; upright side wheels are thin top rims.
